entries.zh: 房；屋子、房间（西释 apostento qualquiera：任意一间的房舍）
entries.en: room; chamber; apartment (aposento cualquiera: any room)

entries.zh: 房间；屋室
entries.en: room; apartment

entries.zh: 间；单间（亦作房屋量词）
entries.en: room (single); classifier for rooms

entries.zh: 后堂；官署正厅之后的后堂（官员内堂）
entries.en: rear hall; the back hall of a mandarin's residence, behind the front reception hall (visita)

entries.zh: 五凤楼；宫中楼阁（本稿释作皇后梳妆之楼）
entries.en: Five Phoenixes Tower, an imperial palace tower (glossed here as the chamber where the empress combed her hair)
entries.notes: 西释“皇后梳妆处”系编者对该宫楼的理解，非字面直译，汉字与对音本身无歧义。

entries.zh: 深宫；宫中内廷深处，后妃所居
entries.en: the inner (deep) palace; the empress's secluded quarters

entries.zh: 寅宾馆；官署接待宾客、钦差下榻之宾馆
entries.en: yinbin guan, official guesthouse for honoured guests and imperial envoys
entries.notes: 西栏文句残乱（do se r: iuen ni li rey &.），释义依汉字“寅宾馆”与两栏对音推断为延宾之所。

entries.zh: 绣房；女子刺绣做针线的房间（闺房）
entries.en: embroidery room; women's needlework chamber (boudoir)

entries.zh: 长房；宗族中长子一房（长子支系，兼指长子所居之房）
entries.en: the eldest son's branch of the family (primogeniture line); also the eldest son's quarters

entries.zh: 赌；打赌、赌博
entries.en: to bet; to wager; to gamble

entries.zh: 赌过；已经赌过（已然之赌）
entries.en: to have (already) bet; has gambled

entries.zh: 赌賠；赌局中下注、照输赢赔付（第二字存疑，或作貯）
entries.en: to stake in a game; to pay out on bets (2nd character uncertain: 賠 'pay forfeit' or 貯 'lay up a stake')
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（[疑:賠/貯]），据西栏 apostar en el juego 取赛局下注赔付义。

entries.zh: 相赌；对赌、互相打赌
entries.en: to wager against each other; a mutual bet

entries.zh: 相输；赌赛认输、输给对方
entries.en: to concede defeat; to lose a wager (to one another)

entries.zh: 相吓；互相恐吓、吓唬对方
entries.en: to threaten or frighten one another; to bluff (listed among the wager terms)
entries.notes: 西栏沿前组写作 apostar，与汉字“相吓”义不合，释义以汉字与两栏对音为准。

entries.zh: 相帮；互相帮助（第二字存疑，或作封）
entries.en: to help one another; mutual assistance (2nd character uncertain: 幫 'help' or 封 'seal')
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（[疑:幫/封]），西栏 Apostaran en vno mj: 残乱，依闽南音写与官话对音取“相帮”义。

entries.zh: 帮大家输赢；替众人押注、包揽各方输赢（赌局中做庄通赌）
entries.en: to stake on everyone's wins and losses; to back or cover all bets in a game (act as stake-holder/banker)
entries.notes: 首字存疑（[疑:幫/憑]）且西栏含抹消字样，据西释 apostando... qualquiera gana 取代众下注之义。

entries.zh: 做谜；出谜语令人猜（猜谜赌胜）
entries.en: to pose a riddle; riddle-guessing (with a wager on guessing it)

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑：汉字疑为相量，较量、估量之义；西栏义为疮肿瘰疬（apostemado, opilado），二者不合〕
entries.en: uncertain: characters tentatively read xiang-liang 'to compare and measure', but the Spanish gloss reads 'abscessed, goitre-swollen' — irreconcilable
entries.notes: 首字存疑（[疑:賬/相]），汉字义与西栏医学义互相矛盾，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 估；估价、估计
entries.en: to estimate; to appraise the value

entries.zh: 估定价；估价定出价格（如立定税则、价目）
entries.en: to appraise and fix a price; to set the tariff (arancel)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏皆[空]，仅存闽南音写 poē-cāē，无字可核；西栏 Aprobar（核准）不足以定字。
